dataset_label: FY2025-26 official Delhi baseline + verified subset of facility nodes.
period: FY2025-26; Economic Survey of Delhi 2025-26 (presented Mar 2026)
rules: No values from 2021-22, 2023-24 or FY2024-25 datasets are used here
Generation and city totals from Statement 8.4; facility capacities from Statement 14.10
City-level reference metrics are NOT assumed to equal the sum of identified facility nodes
Conflicts are attached to values, not silently resolved
No fabricated zone generation, facility load, transport cost, coordinates, or demand

city_reference_metrics._note: City-level reported metrics. Each is its OWN reported figure, not a derived sum of the facility_nodes below. Do not cross-check by summing facility nodes into these.

installed_capacity_tpd.evidence: Reported only in press coverage of the survey (Millennium Post, Daily Pioneer); not yet seen in a numbered Statement. Metric definition: 'installed processing capacity', city-wide, all technologies and scales.

actual_reported_processing_tpd.evidence: Press only (Hans India, quoting the survey); metric definition: actual tonnes processed per day, distinct from installed capacity above.

city_reference_metrics.processing_gap_note: 11862 - 7641 = 4221 (press rounds to '~4200'); 11862 - 7460.3 = 4401.7 (actual, not installed, gap). These are two different gaps depending on which capacity metric is used.

facility_subset._note: FACILITY SUBSET: the four identified WTE facilities from Statement 14.10. This subset's sum (7250) is NOT expected to equal installed_capacity_tpd (7641) above -- see conflict C24. Do not treat 7641 as a target that these four nodes must reconcile to.

status.evidence: The user's message described this capacity figure in the context of a Bio-CNG project replacing 'the existing closed 200 TPD compost plant'. That description is the only status information available. It has NOT been confirmed that the official table itself states the plant's status as closed -- it may be an incidental description rather than a reported field. Do not treat as KNOWN closed until the source statement's exact wording is checked.

old_capacity_tpd.evidence: Same caveat as status: figure appears inside the Bio-CNG proposal description, not confirmed as its own table row.

decentralised_processing._note: Two different metrics appear across sources and must not be combined: INSTALLED CAPACITY (Statement 14.10, per user) vs REPORTED THROUGHPUT (press, citing the same survey's decentralised-processing section). They may describe the same facilities at different points in time, differently scoped facility counts, or simply be inconsistent -- undetermined. Treated as two separate series pending the source tables.
